title: Sweet Potato Cake
ingredients: 8 Tbsp (1 stick) unsalted butter, room temperature
1.5 large eggs, lightly beaten (beat each egg individually, and take 2 tsp of the second egg to add to the first)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and grease a 9 inch springform baking pan.
Line cake pan with parchment paper and grease the paper as well.
In a mixing bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and ginger.
In the bowl of the stand mixer set up with the beater paddle, beat the butter and sugar on medium-high for 4-5 minutes, until fluffy, stopping and scraping the sides down the bowl as needed.
Add the eggs to the stand mixer bowl. Beat again on medium-high for 1-2 minutes until smooth.
Add the vanilla and sweet potatoes to the stand mixer. Beat once more on medium for 1-2 minutes until smooth
Add the remaining dry ingredients to the stand mixer. Beat on low for 1-2 minutes until incorporated.
Pour the batter into the cake pan and tap to even it out.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until an inserted toothpick in the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven, and allow to cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then invert onto a wire rack and allow to cool completely.
Later with cream cheese frosting and serve. Refrigerate if there are leftovers.
